hero.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
hero.description: Learn about the conditions for cancellations, refunds, rescheduling, and other aspects related to our tourism services. We seek to provide you with total transparency before and during your experience with Espeletia Trips.

information.title: Legal information
information.description: Review our cancellation, refund, and rescheduling policies to understand your rights and responsibilities before booking any of our experiences.

notice.title: Important
notice.description: Policies may vary for high-mountain tours, expeditions, or private experiences.
notice.description2: This information will be confirmed before finalizing your booking.

general.title: <0>General Overview</0>
general.content: <0>This policy regulates the applicable terms in case of withdrawal, right of rescission, or cancellation of tourism services contracted with Espeletia Trips.</0>

condition.label: <0>Condition</0>
condition.value: <0>As long as the service has not started.</0>

refund.label: <0>Refund</0>
refund.value: <0>100% of the amount paid within 30 calendar days.</0>

userCancellation.title: <0>ARTICLE 2. Cancellation by the User</0>
userCancellation.note: <0>Note: </0>Cancellations must be notified to the agency in writing.

exceptionalSituations.title: <0>ARTICLE 4. Exceptional Situations</0>
exceptionalSituations.content: <0>In case of natural factors or extraordinary situations (volcanic activity, road closures, landslides, fires, among others), costs already incurred for transportation, meals, lodging, guiding, and insurance policies will not be refundable.</0>

items.deadline: <0>Allowed up to 48 hours before the tour.</0>
items.requirements: <0>The new traveler must meet all requirements.</0>

contact.title: <0>Do you have questions about this policy?</0>
contact.intro: <0>For more information or requests regarding cancellations and refunds, you can reach out to us:</0>

summary.title: Policy Summary
summary.description: Quickly check the general cancellation and refund conditions before reviewing the full details of each article.

item1.title: Cancellation over 15 days in advance
item1.description: Cancel more than 15 days in advance and receive 90% of the amount paid.

item2.title: Between 8 and 14 days
item2.description: You will receive 70% of the booking value.

item3.title: Between 2 and 7 days
item3.description: 50% of the amount paid will be refunded.

item4.title: Extreme weather
item4.description: If weather conditions prevent the tour from taking place, you will be able to reschedule.
